overview.title: Cloud infrastructure and delivery pipelines you can trust.
overview.description: Release anxiety is a symptom of missing infrastructure, not missing heroics. Manual deployments, environment drift, and absent observability create a culture of fear that slows everything down. Forgeone helps organizations migrate to cloud-native architectures, implement CI/CD pipelines, and establish DevOps practices that reduce incidents while accelerating delivery. We build systems where shipping software feels boring — and boring is exactly what you want.
highlights: AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud migration and optimization
CI/CD pipeline design with automated testing and rollback
Infrastructure as code with Terraform and CloudFormation
Container orchestration with Docker and Kubernetes
Centralized observability — logging, metrics, and distributed tracing

faqs.title: Common questions about cloud and DevOps.

items.question: Which cloud platform do you recommend?
items.answer: It depends on your existing investments, compliance requirements, and team expertise. We work across AWS, Azure, and GCP — and recommend based on total cost of ownership, service availability, and your team's ability to operate the platform long-term.

items.question: Can you migrate our system without downtime?
items.answer: Yes. We use phased migration strategies — strangler-fig patterns, blue-green deployments, and database replication — that allow incremental cutover without service interruption. Every migration plan includes rollback procedures.

items.question: How quickly can we expect to see results?
items.answer: Most teams see meaningful improvement within the first 4–6 weeks — automated deployments, basic observability, and environment parity. Full DevOps transformation typically takes 3–6 months depending on system complexity.

items.question: Do you work with our existing engineering team?
items.answer: Always. DevOps transformation only sticks when your team owns the practices. We pair on every pipeline, every Terraform module, and every runbook — building capability, not dependency.

items.question: How do you handle cloud security during migration?
items.answer: Security is embedded in every phase: network segmentation, IAM policies, encryption at rest and in transit, secrets management, and compliance validation. We follow cloud provider security best practices and your organization's policies.
